CustomField.label: Approver
CustomField.description: Who must sign this invitee off: the submitter's manager. Resolved once at submit time and frozen, so an org-chart change mid-approval cannot reroute an item somebody is already looking at. R5 collapsed the three-rung ladder to this one rung — the Account Owner rung died with the Account, and the Lead Owner rung with the Lead, leaving what requirement.md asked for in the first place. This is the Approval Process's Related User Field; an approval process can only route to a stored User lookup, which is why it is not a formula.
